fee_notes: The Initial Franchise Fee is $50,000, paid in two installments: $25,000 due upon signing the Franchise Agreement (non-refundable), and $25,000 due upon execution of a lease for the Licensed Restaurant (refundable under limited circumstances). The fee is uniform for all franchises. Additional fees include: a $15,000 nonrefundable extension fee to extend exclusive Reserved Area rights for 3 months if a lease is not secured within 6 months; a $5,000 nonrefundable extension fee to extend the time to sign a Franchise Agreement beyond 90 days; a $10,000 fee for a Brand Standards Agreement (direct construction assistance) or a $35,000 fee for a Franchise Operator Construction Management Agreement (full construction management by RIU), both refundable if a lease and construction cannot begin; and opening assistance reimbursement of $6,500 to $21,500 for representatives' travel, lodging, meals, and car rental.
raw_excerpt: The "Initial Franchise Fee" is $50,000, one half of which ($25,000) is due and payable when you sign your Franchise Agreement. This portion of the Initial Franchise Fee is not refundable. ... When you execute a lease for the Licensed Restaurant, you must pay us the remaining half of the Initial Franchise Fee ($25,000). ... The Initial Franchise Fee is uniform for all franchises which we presently offer in this State.
